model.hardware: Apple M3 Pro, 12 CPU cores, 18 GPU cores, 36 GiB unified memory

protocol.output_cap_amended_before_inference: Raised from 768 after tokenizer-only sizing; pretty reference JSON needed up to 979 tokens. No response-based retry.

observed.memory_caveat: Host-wide counters, not isolated attribution. Earlier smoke increased global swap-out by about 2.97 GB; existing swap remained. MLX allocation is not whole-process physical footprint.

decision.reason: Arithmetic errors, incorrect verdicts, incomplete evidence provenance and one incomplete rule. Correct formulas did not imply correct reported numbers. Finite probe success is not a general correctness proof.
decision.scope: First non-thinking configuration only; not a claim that every Qwen configuration fails. Model proposals cannot authorize electrical acceptance.

partial_parent_usage_proxy.scope: Mixed root-task preparation, coordination, concurrent acceptance/publication and UI discussion. Child coverage unverified. Excludes later evaluation, analysis, UI setup and performance work. Not isolated pilot cost, billing, a team total or demonstrated savings. Do not sum overlapping snapshots.

reproducibility_limit: Raw prompts, oracle, runner, outputs, package receipts and weights remain local under work/. This compact record is not a portable installer, reproducible public test package or current engineering evidence.
